title: Scroll Lightning
html:
A spell scroll that drops from monsters.

How to get it

Teaches Lightning, a level-3 Shock spell. Needs 30 Intellect and Shock skill 15 to learn and to cast.

Drops from monsters that cast Shock spells, level 18+.

  • A monster that casts spells drops scrolls of its own school, so look for Shock casters.
  • The monster’s level picks the spell level: 8+ drops level-2 scrolls, 18+ level-3 and 30+ level-4.
No monster drops recorded for this item.
